about.title: We lay floors, and we do the prep ourselves
about.lead: Jaya Nexus is a flooring contractor based in Seri Kembangan, Selangor. We have been installing commercial floors since {year}.
about.story1: Most floor failures start under the floor: a damp slab, old adhesive, a dip that nobody levelled. That's why we don't hand the prep to someone else. The same crew that grinds and screeds the slab also lays the vinyl and welds the seams, so nobody can blame the trade before them.
about.story2: We work mostly in hospitals, clinics, schools, data centres and offices, often while the building stays open. We plan the work zone by zone, keep dust behind screens, and hand each area back clean before we move on.

precision.title: Precision
precision.body: We level to ±2 mm over 2 m, record moisture readings before we lay, and set out every room so the cuts at the walls come out even.

clean.title: Clean sites
clean.body: Dust screens, covered walkways and a clean-up at the end of every shift, not just at handover.

live.title: Live buildings
live.body: We have replaced floors in a working emergency department. We phase the work so wards, classrooms and offices stay in use.

about.teamBody: Photos and names of our supervisors and installers will go here.
about.registrationsBody: We are a registered Malaysian company. Registration numbers are listed below.
about.equipmentBody: Everything here belongs to us and comes to site with our crew. We don't sell or rent it out.
about.weld1: Sheet vinyl comes in rolls about 2 m wide, so any room bigger than that has seams. Left as a plain butt joint, a seam opens slightly over time. Water and cleaning chemicals get in, the edges lift, and dirt and bacteria collect in the gap.
about.weld2: So we cut a groove along each seam with a seam groover, then run a hot-air welding gun along it, melting a vinyl weld rod into the groove. The rod fuses with both sheets. When it cools we trim it flush with a spatula knife. The result is one continuous, sealed surface that can be scrubbed and disinfected without anything getting underneath.
about.weld3: Together with coved skirting at the walls, that's what infection-control specs in hospitals and clinics ask for.
